{20,000|Twenty thousand} emus are raiding the wheat. So the major mounts a gun on a truck. The emus outrun it, and the ride's too rough to shoot.
After six days and bad press, the army pulls out. The major says they can face machine guns with the invulnerability of tanks.
Then the farmers ask them back. Round two.
Four weeks later, he's recalled for good. His count: {986|nine hundred and eighty-six} birds, for {9,860|nine thousand, eight hundred and sixty} rounds.
Exactly ten rounds a bird. Suspiciously tidy.
